data.name: Cereal Reaper
data.detailed_description:
What this?

Cereal Reaper is a game where a cereal addicted freak runs out of cereal and does whatever it takes to get more. Find goofy characters on your journey and beat people up on your way to find the greatest breakfast ever.

Collect items and fight! (if you feel like it)

On the way, find tons of items that make you more powerful to slay more powerful bosses! If you don't want to do that, just do it less. Sometimes violence is the right solution though. There are no random enemy encounters so feel free to explore all corners of the map without any trouble!

Talk to people to find out more things about the world!

There are hundreds of characters around the world to talk to! Some more useful than others, but reading is very good! You should do it more.

GO FAST!!!

The game has many features designed for speedrunning. This makes replaying the game for the purpose of beating it quickly more fun! The game has an ingame timer built in so don't bother with any external tools!
